expected_findings.description: selectedGroupType always equals g because both pickers resolve a recent row to its source group before calling onChange, and the handler also serves the event, action and cohort pickers; drop the override and pass g as before to keep the change scoped to the person field.

The operator dropdown (CohortMathOperatorField) and excludeUnsupportedRecent each decide separately which operator list a person property gets (date vs non-date), so the picker can show recents the editor cannot display. Extract a shared helper and read the operator lists from FIELD_VALUES, which lets allowedRecentOperators become a boolean and COHORT_PERSON_RECENT_OPERATORS go away.

hasRecentContext(item) gives a typed propertyFilter without the cast, the person-filter guards from PropertyFilters/utils.ts can replace the type comparisons, and recentPersonFilter holds an operator and value rather than a filter, so rename it.
